name: Publication extension: spatial scale and observation-source transport of SST skill
scope: Retrospective publication extension after all original 2010-2025, OISST 2026 and AMSR2 2026 scores were viewed. The frozen original forecasts and primary external rules remain unchanged. New weighted EOF-AR spatial-increment controls are fitted to 2010-2019 only and selected on 2020-2021 seven-day gridded MSE; all new test analyses are exploratory, not an untouched confirmatory holdout. Loss decomposition is an exact diagnostic identity and cannot identify latent truth or establish a discrepancy lower bound. Grid-to-land distance uses first-day missing OISST cell centers within the acquired box, not a precise coastline or bathymetry.
